newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares drift ahead of elections.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares drift ahead of elections.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.17 percent on Tuesday on low turnover and traders expect a lack of incentives to keep trading range-bound over the short-term.
"There is not enough fresh money on the market and we could expect some fresh money just after the elections," Davor Dubokovic, a trader at Eastbrokers said.
Slovenia is due to hold general elections on November 10.
* The SBI index fell 2.01 points to 1,188.10.
* Overall 14 shares were untraded, five fell and five rose.
* Turnover fell to 92.6 million tolars from 107.7 million. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
